learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn to use a 100-grid to add, subtract, and find patterns with numbers!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A number grid is a giant house with 100 rooms! If you move one step right, the number goes up by 1. If you move left, it goes down by 1.
If you want to add 10 quickly, just jump one step down in the grid! To subtract 10, just jump one step up. It is like a number elevator!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Number Elevator Game
fun_activity.instructions: Draw a small grid from 1 to 30. Put a button on 15. Tell the button to take the elevator up 10 steps or down 10 steps!

quick_recap: ⭐ A 100-grid helps us see amazing number patterns.
⭐ Moving up and down the grid is a super-fast way to add or subtract 10.
